tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get one certified record by record_id, from either collection (ids are globally unique), e.g. "OK-PERMIT-2026-04835" (a permit) or "OK-ROOF-2026-0003" (an insurance/roofing fact). tools.name: get_record_history
tools.description: Get the full revision lineage for a record -- every certified record it supersedes or was superseded by, oldest first. Use after get_record or search_records to see how a rule or permit record changed over time.
